source.stem:
The table describes four different resistance wires. They are all made from the same metal.
Which wire has the smallest resistance?

options.text: length of diameter of wire / m 2.0; wire / mm 1.0
length of diameter of wire / m 2.0; wire / mm 1.5
length of diameter of wire / m 3.0; wire / mm 1.0
length of diameter of wire / m 3.0; wire / mm 1.5

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: concave mirror is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: The reflecting surface of the concave mirror faces the Sun.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when The reflecting surface of the concave mirror faces the Sun is not true.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Judge from the most visible feature in the figure, not from the mechanism's test.

intelligence.enrichment: A concave mirror can concentrate sunlight reflected from its surface into a small bright spot, producing enough heat there to ignite paper. converging reflected sunlight concentrates energy at a small area and raises temperature there The learner explains that a concave mirror can focus reflected sunlight into a small bright spot where concentrated light produces enough heat to ignite paper. A concave mirror burns paper simply because sunlight touches the mirror; forming a small bright spot is not necessary.
